System Overview

The Travel Reservation System is a web-based application designed to allow passengers in Mindanao, Philippines to book travel reservations across land, air, and sea transportation. Users can select origin and destination locations, choose a vehicle type, specify travel dates, and receive a printable ticket with a QR code for verification.

User Journey: Making a Reservation

StepWhat User DoesWhat System Does
1Opens website URLFlask checks session, redirects to login if not logged in
2Registers / Logs inPassword is SHA-256 hashed and compared with DB; session created
3Views DashboardFlask queries DB for user's reservations and renders dashboard
4Clicks Book ReservationOpens reservation.html with map, vehicle selector, location dropdowns
5Fills form and submitsFlask validates data, calculates fare (distance x rate), generates ticket number
6Views TicketFlask renders ticket.html with QR code image embedded
7Prints TicketBrowser print dialog shows the formatted ticket
8Verifier scans QRQR links to /verify/ticket_number — Flask shows ticket details

Fare Calculation Formula

💰
Total Fare = Distance (km) x Rate per km x Number of Passengers
Distance is calculated using the Haversine formula from GPS coordinates of origin and destination obtained via the Nominatim geocoding API.

Database Structure

The system uses SQLite stored as travel_reservation.db. No separate database server is needed — it is a single file.

Table: users

ColumnTypeDescription
idINTEGER PRIMARY KEYAuto-incrementing unique user ID
usernameTEXT UNIQUEUser's login username
passwordTEXTSHA-256 hashed password (never stored plain)
full_nameTEXTPassenger's full name
emailTEXTEmail address
created_atDATETIMEAccount creation timestamp

Table: reservations

ColumnTypeDescription
idINTEGER PRIMARY KEYAuto-incrementing reservation ID
user_idINTEGER (FK)Links to users.id
ticket_numberTEXT UNIQUEUnique generated ticket code
vehicle_typeTEXTBus / Van / Taxi / Motor / Airplane / Ferry
originTEXTDeparture location name
destinationTEXTArrival location name
travel_dateTEXTScheduled travel date
passengersINTEGERNumber of passengers
total_fareREALComputed total fare in Philippine Peso (₱)
distance_kmREALCalculated route distance in kilometers
statusTEXTactive / cancelled
passenger_nameTEXTName of the traveler
origin_barangayTEXTSpecific barangay in origin city
destination_barangayTEXTSpecific barangay in destination city
created_atDATETIMEBooking timestamp
⚠️
SQLite on Render (Free Tier): The free Render plan uses ephemeral disk — the .db file resets on every new deploy. For permanent storage, upgrade to a persistent disk or switch to PostgreSQL.
9
QR Code Generation

Every ticket gets a unique QR code generated by the qrcode Python library. When scanned, it opens the verification URL for that specific ticket.

How QR Codes Are Generated

# Route: /ticket/<ticket_number>/qr.png
import qrcode, io
from flask import Response, url_for

@app.route("/ticket/<ticket_number>/qr.png")
def generate_qr(ticket_number):
    # 1. Build the verification URL for this ticket
    verify_url = url_for('verify', ticket_number=ticket_number, _external=True)

    # 2. Create QR code object with the URL
    qr = qrcode.QRCode(box_size=8, border=2)
    qr.add_data(verify_url)
    qr.make(fit=True)

    # 3. Convert to PNG image stored in memory (no disk write)
    img = qr.make_image(fill_color="black", back_color="white")
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf, format='PNG')

    # 4. Return PNG as HTTP response directly
    return Response(buf.getvalue(), mimetype='image/png')
StepWhat Happens
1. Ticket CreatedSystem generates a unique ticket number (e.g. TKT-20261012-A3F2)
2. QR URL BuiltURL = https://wifey-project-system02.onrender.com/verify/TKT-20261012-A3F2
3. QR Image Generatedqrcode library encodes the URL into a black-and-white PNG matrix
4. Embedded in TicketTicket page loads QR via <img src="/ticket/TKT-.../qr.png">
5. Scan & VerifyScanner opens URL, Flask shows ticket details to confirm it is valid

Map & Route Feature

The system uses Leaflet.js combined with OpenStreetMap to display an interactive map showing the travel route. No Google Maps API key is required.

Map Components

ComponentRole
Leaflet.jsRenders the interactive map tiles and markers in the browser
OpenStreetMap TilesProvides the actual map imagery (roads, cities, geography)
Nominatim APIConverts place names (e.g. "Davao City") to GPS lat/lng coordinates
Flask /api/search-addressProxy route that calls Nominatim and returns GPS data as JSON
Flask /api/calculate-routeCalculates straight-line distance in km between two GPS points
Haversine FormulaMath to compute accurate distance between two GPS coordinates on Earth

Address Search Flow

User selects location
→
JS calls /api/search-address
→
Flask queries Nominatim
→
Returns lat/lng JSON
→
Leaflet pins marker
→
Route line drawn
✅
100% Free Maps! The system uses OpenStreetMap + Leaflet.js — completely free and open-source. No Google Maps API key or billing required.
